title: Kubernetes Deployment
summary: We orchestrate containerized applications with Kubernetes, using Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, and Secrets.

content.overview: We deploy and manage applications on Kubernetes to handle scaling, networking, and configuration management.
content.details: We leverage Pods (smallest deployable units), Deployments (manage replica sets and rolling updates), Services (expose pods reliably), ConfigMaps (non-sensitive configuration), and Secrets (sensitive data).
